verdict.rationale: Flagright's own homepage names a Rule Simulation feature to "simulate and test rules," and the docs show a dedicated sandbox API environment, so pre-activation testing is a first-party capability. The evidence is only a one-line marketing claim, with no documentation of how simulation works. missing for 10: documentation that simulation runs against historical transaction data (backtesting), explanation of how simulated rules relate to activating rule instances, any description of simulation outputs (hit rates, alert impact), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can test proposed detection rules against historical or sandbox events before activation

citations.quote: Rule Simulation - Simulate and test rules in seconds without engineers.
